title: Scalar conjugation for localized structural coefficients
statement: Let j:Y→X be etale [def-pc-scheme,def-weil-etale-morphism]. Compose j inverse image of the inverse canonical unit-structure isomorphism [new-unit-structure-coefficient-iso] with the normalized coherent restriction [def-weil-pbc-coherent-etale-restriction], obtaining e:j^-1 A_X ≅ (j* O_X)_et. If μ is an endomorphism of j^-1 A_X whose localization-restriction component at every T→Y is multiplication by the restriction of r∈Γ(Y,O_Y), then μ followed by e equals e followed by coherentEtaleMap of smulHom r. No cohomology or higher-image realization is involved.

proof.text: At T→Y, the inverse coefficient map followed by localization restriction sends s to the unit structural coordinate of c(T,j)(s). Prove this from the defining normalization of coherentEtaleRestrictionIso, naturality of localization restriction and the component formula of unitStructureCoefficientIso. The two module morphisms in that coordinate map are linear over Γ(T,O_T). The coherent multiplication component is multiplication by T.hom.appTop r. Substitute the stipulated formula for μ, use linearity, and cancel the localization and coefficient isomorphisms. Sectionwise equality proves equality of sheaf maps.
